text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Now the ground's all slippery,
and—wh-whoa!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A-are you okay? It's bett'r to shuffle
your feet
when you're walk'n across
snowy roads.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
S'right! You won't topple ov'r if you take
short
steps, slide your feet, and lean
forw'rd.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I had no idea... It's practically the
opposite
of how models walk down the
runway.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So be my teacher, okay? When you say
"lean
forward," do you mean like this?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, don't overreact. Come on, teach
me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Uh... Go ahead and bend your
knees a
t'nsy bit more... uh, if you
please.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, move your center of gravity forw'rd.
Oth'rwise
you'll slip backwards and
smack your head.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You'll be fine. Focus on moving forw'rd if
you fall.
That way, ya won't hurt yourself
too badly.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Stay alert, and icy roads are noth'n to
fear.
Walking on 'em can even help train
your low'r
body!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, interesting... You're so
dependable,
Teacher.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-y-you really mean that? If it helps you
out, you
can ask me 'bout this kinda
stuff whenev'r you
fancy!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Today's my opportunity to repay you for
always
teach'n me about city life!
